text.p: Lityan Holdings Bhd said it has received approval from the Securities Commission for its proposed acquisition of the remaining 70 percent stake in Konsortium Jaya Sdn Bhd (KJSB), a telecommunications equipment supply and services company.
The acquisition, for 70 million ringgit, would be satisfied by the issue of 8.235 million new Lityan shares at 8.50 ringgit per share, it said in a statement.

Lityan said the Securities Commission approval is subject to KJSB not distributing any dividends or any of its reserves to its existing shareholders before the completion of the acquisition and a profit guarantee of 70 million ringgit for the three years ending December 31, 1998.
The vendor of the stake also intends to seek a waiver from obligations to make a general offer for Lityan shares, the statement said.
